svg.text: ENTERPRISE AI INCIDENT RESPONSE, SUB-SECOND KILL-SWITCH & QUARANTINE ARCHITECTURE
Cut AI Incident MTTM from 42 Min to 1.8 Sec While Preserving 94.5% Live Availability
25 Production AI Apps / 8,000 Peak Users: Tier 1 CI/CD Redeploy (2,520s, $280K/mo) vs. Tier 2 Partial Rollback vs. Tier 4 4-Level Kill-Switch (1.8s, $27K/mo)
⛔ Tier 1 & 2 Traps: 42-Min Redeploys & Poisoned Caches
1. CI/CD Container Redeploy or Global Plug-Pull (Tier 1: 42 Min):
• Waiting 42 min for Docker build + K8s rollout during a viral
jailbreak or rogue tool bug—or pulling the global API key (0% uptime!)
2. Residual Poisoned Semantic Cache & Vector Chunks (Tier 2: 34%):
• Rolling back a prompt or SharePoint PDF leaves poisoned `$0.00`
answers active inside Redis Semantic Cache for hours!
3. Coarse HTTP 503 Circuit Breaker (Tier 3: 18% Availability):
• Kills 92% healthy read-only Q&A just because 1 write tool broke
Production Failure Impact (18 P1/P2 AI Incidents/Year):
• Mean Time to Mitigate (MTTM): 2,520s (42 min) in Tier 1
• Residual Poisoned Cache Hits After Fix: 34.0%–42.0%
• Monthly Blast-Radius & SLA Penalty Cost: $280,000 / month
🏆 Tier 4: 4-Level 1.8s Kill-Switch + Quarantine + Ladder
1. Surgical Tool-Level Kill-Switch (`800ms` via Envoy/AppConfig):
• Disables only the rogue mutating tool (`issue_refund=OFF`) while
keeping 92% read-only Q&A & tracking 100% online!
2. Instant `doc_id` Vector Tombstone + Tagged Cache Purge (`1.2s`):
• Adds bad `doc_id` to gateway deny-bitmap & evicts all Redis semantic
cache entries tagged with `doc_id` or `prompt_v` in 1.2 seconds
3. 3-Step Graceful Degradation Ladder (`Write -> Read RAG -> Search`):
• Falls back to deterministic citation cards instead of HTTP 503
Tier 4 Verified Production Benchmarks:
• Mean Time to Mitigate (MTTM): 1.8 sec (1,400x faster than Tier 1)
• Availability Preserved During Incident: 94.5% | Poison Leak: 0.0%
• Monthly Incident TCO: $27,000 / mo (-90.4% savings vs. Tier 1)
